canonical_example.text: The Buddha statue is made of jade.
canonical_example.translation: La estatua de Buda está hecha de jade.

canonical_example.text: That jade scarf will look wonderful with your coat.
canonical_example.translation: Esa bufanda verde jade se verá genial con tu abrigo.

canonical_example.text: La provincia de Madrid tiene más y más habitantes cada año.
canonical_example.translation: The province of Madrid has more and more inhabitants every year.

canonical_example.text: Hay muchos hablantes de polaco en Argentina.
canonical_example.translation: There are a lot of Polish speakers in Argentina.

canonical_example.text: Me hice amigo de dos polacos y de un rumano en mi viaje por Europa del Este.
canonical_example.translation: I made friends with two Poles and a Romanian on my trip around Eastern Europe.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuelo era polaco, pero vivió la mayor parte de su vida en Francia.
canonical_example.translation: My grandfather was Polish, but he lived in France for most of his life.

canonical_example.text: Un polaco le puso esposas al delincuente.
canonical_example.translation: A cop put the criminal in handcuffs.

canonical_example.text: Creo que el logotipo lo ha hecho uno de esos diseñadores polacos que están tan de moda.
canonical_example.translation: I think the logo was the work of one of those trendy Catalan designers.

canonical_example.text: Júpiter tiene varios satélites y la Tierra solo uno.
canonical_example.translation: Jupiter has several satellites and the Earth only has one.

canonical_example.text: El satélite transmite a la Tierra información sobre el espacio.
canonical_example.translation: The satellite transmits information about space to Earth.

canonical_example.text: Los satélites del cantante buscaban hacerse conocidos en el mundo de la música.
canonical_example.translation: The singer's henchmen tried to make a name for themselves in the music world too.

canonical_example.text: Mi amigo Juan es un satélite que me acompaña a todas partes.
canonical_example.translation: My friend Juan is one of my cronies who comes with me everywhere.

canonical_example.text: Los detractores acusaron al país de ser un estado satélite.
canonical_example.translation: The detractors accused the nation of being a satellite state.

canonical_example.text: Se pasó el día entero espiando a sus vecinos con unos binoculares.
canonical_example.translation: He spent the whole day spying on his neighbors with a set of binoculars.

canonical_example.text: La policía sospechaba de él y espiaba sus movimientos.
canonical_example.translation: The police suspected him and was keeping watch on his actions.

canonical_example.text: Era una situación terrible, en la que todos espiaban a todos.
canonical_example.translation: It was a terrible situation, where everyone kept a watch on everyone else.

canonical_example.text: Durante la Guerra Fría, espió para ambos bandos.
canonical_example.translation: She spied for both sides during the Cold War.

canonical_example.text: El resultado en el marcador del estadio no es el correcto.
canonical_example.translation: The score on the stadium scoreboard isn't right.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo va el marcador? - Gana San Lorenzo 1-0.
canonical_example.translation: What's the score? - San Lorenzo's winning 1-0.

canonical_example.text: La maestra siempre usa marcador azul cuando escribe en la pizarra.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher always uses blue marker when she writes on the whiteboard.

canonical_example.text: Te envío un mapa electrónico que te muestra mi domicilio con un marcador rojo.
canonical_example.translation: I'm sending you an online map that shows my address with a red marker.

canonical_example.text: Me gusta corregir mis escritos con marcador rojo.
canonical_example.translation: I like to correct my writing with a red felt-tip pen.

canonical_example.text: Mi hija me hizo un marcador con una hoja.
canonical_example.translation: My daughter made me a bookmark with a leaf.

canonical_example.text: Este nuevo buscador sincroniza los marcadores.
canonical_example.translation: This new browser synchronizes bookmarks.

canonical_example.text: El poste marcador está pintado de rojo.
canonical_example.translation: The marking post is painted red.

canonical_example.text: Dice que lo hace por mi bien, pero yo creo que solo quiere controlarme.
canonical_example.translation: He says he does it for my own good, but I think all he wants is to control me.

canonical_example.text: El botón de la derecha permite controlar el flujo de aire.
canonical_example.translation: The knob on the right allows you to control the air flow.

canonical_example.text: ¡Contrólate un poco! No puedes decir siempre lo primero que se te viene a la cabeza.
canonical_example.translation: Control yourself a bit! You cannot always say the first thing that comes to your mind.

canonical_example.text: Se puso nervioso al ver que no controlaba la situación.
canonical_example.translation: He became nervous when he realized he wasn't in control of the situation.

canonical_example.text: El ejército controla ya el norte del país.
canonical_example.translation: The army already has the north of the country under control.

canonical_example.text: Los bomberos lograron controlar el incendio luego de dos horas.
canonical_example.translation: The firefighters managed to bring the fire under control after two hours.

canonical_example.text: Si no controlas tus impulsos, dominarán tu vida.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't get your impulses under control, they'll shape your life.

canonical_example.text: El médico me dijo que tenía que controlar mi peso.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor told me I had to watch my weight.

canonical_example.text: Es fundamental controlar el ritmo cardíaco del paciente durante la cirugía.
canonical_example.translation: It is essential to monitor the patient's heart rate during surgery.

canonical_example.text: Mi trabajo consiste en controlar que se respeten las normas.
canonical_example.translation: My job involves making sure that rules are observed.

canonical_example.text: Controla la salsa para que no se queme.
canonical_example.translation: Keep an eye on the sauce and don't let it burn.

canonical_example.text: ¿Te encargas tú de controlar el tiempo?
canonical_example.translation: Can you keep a check on the time, please?

canonical_example.text: De química sabe un rato, pero la física no la controla mucho.
canonical_example.translation: She knows a hell of a lot about chemistry, but she doesn't know much about physics.

canonical_example.text: Se controla lo que come porque quiere llegar flaca al verano.
canonical_example.translation: She watches what she eats because she wants to be skinny for summer.

canonical_example.text: Es diabético y tiene que controlarse los niveles de azúcar continuamente.
canonical_example.translation: He is a diabetic and has to monitor his sugar levels continuously.

canonical_example.text: Cubrí los muebles porque van a pintar el salón.
canonical_example.translation: I covered the furniture because we're having the living room painted.

canonical_example.text: Cúbreme mientras corro a recoger la munición caída.
canonical_example.translation: Cover me while I run to pick up the fallen ammo.

canonical_example.text: Mis ahorros deben cubrir cualquier gasto imprevisto.
canonical_example.translation: My savings should cover any emergency expenses.

canonical_example.text: La red de noticias envió a un reportero para cubrir el evento.
canonical_example.translation: The news network sent a reporter to cover the event.

canonical_example.text: Trató de cubrir su tristeza con una sonrisa.
canonical_example.translation: He tried to cover up his sadness with a smile.

canonical_example.text: Intentó cubrir el moretón con maquillaje, pero todos se dieron cuenta.
canonical_example.translation: She tried to conceal the bruise with makeup, but everybody noticed.

canonical_example.text: Cancelaron mi entrevista porque ya habían cubierto el puesto.
canonical_example.translation: They canceled my interview because they already had filled the position.

canonical_example.text: El entrenador le ordenó a los defensas que cubrieran a los jugadores sin cubrir.
canonical_example.translation: The coach instructed the defense to cover the open players.

canonical_example.text: Cubrimos cinco millas a pie en dos horas.
canonical_example.translation: We covered five miles on foot in two hours.

canonical_example.text: Un vaso de leche al día no cubre tus necesidades diarias de calcio.
canonical_example.translation: One glass of milk a day does not meet your daily calcium needs.

canonical_example.text: Con el dinero que heredó de su tío, pudo cubrir su hipoteca.
canonical_example.translation: With the money inherited from his uncle, he could cover his mortgage.

canonical_example.text: Pagan $100 para perros de raza a cubrir sus perras mientras están en celo.
canonical_example.translation: They are paying $100 for purebreds to cover their dogs while they're in heat.

canonical_example.text: Cúbrete que estás tiritando.
canonical_example.translation: Cover yourself. You are shivering.

canonical_example.text: Cúbrete o pillarás un resfriado.
canonical_example.translation: Cover up, or you'll get a cold.

canonical_example.text: Para evitar los golpes de calor, cúbrete cuando salgas.
canonical_example.translation: To avoid heat stroke, put on your hat when you go outside.

canonical_example.text: Solo está tratando de cubrirse contra cualquier acusación.
canonical_example.translation: He is just trying to cover himself against any accusation.

canonical_example.text: Por la mañana, el bosque se había cubierto de nieve.
canonical_example.translation: In the morning, the forest was covered in snow.

canonical_example.text: De repente, el cielo se cubrió y empezó a llover.
canonical_example.translation: Suddenly, the sky became overcast and it started raining.

canonical_example.text: Lo han pillado robando un coche.
canonical_example.translation: He has been caught stealing a car.

canonical_example.text: Nos robaron en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: We were robbed in the street.

canonical_example.text: El bolso robado apareció, pero los ladrones se habían llevado el dinero que contenía.
canonical_example.translation: The stolen purse appeared, but the thieves had taken the money from it.

canonical_example.text: Robaron a una niña del colegio.
canonical_example.translation: A girl was abducted from the school.

canonical_example.text: Robaron al bebé de los brazos de su madre.
canonical_example.translation: The baby was kidnapped from his mother's arms.

canonical_example.text: Tienes que robarle cartas a tu oponente.
canonical_example.translation: You have to draw cards from your opponent.

canonical_example.text: Robaron en mi apartamento la semana pasada pero no se llevaron nada.
canonical_example.translation: My apartment was broken into last week but nothing was taken.

canonical_example.text: Los policías arrestaron a los hombres que escondían el cuadro robado.
canonical_example.translation: The policemen arrested the men who were hiding the robbed painting.

canonical_example.text: Los paparazzi consiguieron un robado de la actriz desnuda en la playa.
canonical_example.translation: Paparazzi got a candid photo of the actress naked on the beach.

canonical_example.text: El sábado es el mejor día de la semana porque no hay escuela.
canonical_example.translation: Saturday is the best day of the week because there's no school.

canonical_example.text: En Marte, no vive nada.
canonical_example.translation: Nothing lives on Mars.

canonical_example.text: Todavía vivo en casa de mis padres.
canonical_example.translation: I still live at my parent's house.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro país vivió momentos trágicos en el pasado.
canonical_example.translation: Our country has lived through tragedy in the past.

canonical_example.text: La gente de aquí vive de la caza.
canonical_example.translation: The people here live off hunting.

canonical_example.text: No es rico, pero tiene un buen vivir.
canonical_example.translation: He is not rich but he has a good lifestyle.

canonical_example.text: Una tercera guerra mundial sería un auténtico apocalipsis.
canonical_example.translation: A third world war would be a real apocalypse.
